common.appTagline: PaaS Platform for IoT, Digital Twins, and Metaverses

landing.heroTitle: Intelligent Infrastructure for IoT and Digital Twins
landing.heroSubtitle: High-throughput ingestion with MQTT (EMQX), scalable time-series storage with TimescaleDB, real-time dashboards, and native simulation support.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Engineered for researchers, enterprise, and developers requiring extreme performance and live analytics.
landing.featureMqttDesc: Powered by EMQX with cryptographic HTTP authentication per sensor (betty_live_... prefix).
landing.featureRealtimeDesc: Bidirectional WebSocket gateway backed by Dragonfly memory-cached Pub/Sub.
landing.featureTimescaleDesc: PostgreSQL 16 with TimescaleDB Hypertables for lightning-fast aggregation over millions of data points.
landing.featureMetaverseDesc: Classify and correlate real-world hardware telemetry with 3D virtual simulation twins.
landing.featureTeamsDesc: Workspaces with roles (owner, team_admin, member, viewer), secure invite tokens and instant join codes.
landing.featureDashboardsDesc: 6 modular widget types with drag & drop layout and public open-access publishing.
landing.step1Desc: Generate a cryptographic API key to authenticate your hardware device or digital twin.
landing.step2Desc: Send JSON payloads to the dedicated MQTT topic betty/sensor/:id/data.
landing.step3Desc: Build live dashboards with charts, maps and gauges, and share them with teammates or publicly.
landing.codeSnippetSubtitle: Publish telemetry over standard MQTT with any client or programming language.
landing.readyCtaTitle: Ready to Deploy Your Telemetry Infrastructure?
landing.readyCtaSubtitle: Sign up for free, register your devices, and monitor in real-time with zero scale friction.
landing.footerText: Betty PaaS — Open Platform for Digital Twins and IoT.
